summary.pipeline: Same YOLO11s tiled boat detections and DINOv3 cropped ship reference as validation

detector.name: YOLO11s COCO boat
detector.selection_policy: largest-area boat after merged NMS; confidence breaks equal-area ties
detector.fallback: CLAHE luminance contrast, only if raw whole-image and tile passes find no boats

ratio_filter.definition: width / height of nonzero unaugmented foreground mask bounds

summary.note: Threshold tuned on these development images. Reported rates are in-sample; an independent held-out test is required.
